project.name: Parallel Consumer for Apache Kafka
project.description: Parallel Apache Kafka client wrapper with client side queueing, a simpler consumer/producer API with key concurrency and extendable non-blocking IO processing.

target.echo: - NOT in this build: the 8 foreign-language clients (go, python, typescript, rust, dotnet, ruby, cpp, swift).
- Add -Dpc.foreignClients to build and test them.
- That needs go, node, cargo, dotnet and ruby on PATH, plus Docker for cpp and swift.
